summary: A rural resident asks how far someone must go to get a device working again.
realLife: Washington HB 1483 (2025). Senate supporters described rural residents facing greater difficulty keeping electronics in service.
inGame: needs: the resident lives outside the service area of the available shop.
gates: The resident lives outside the service area of the available shop.

turns.pulledBy: A local provider takes the job.

turns.what: Mail delivery saves only part of the journey.
turns.pulledBy: The part comes by mail but the shop still needs the device.
turns.writesBack: The resident makes one trip with both.
